title: NYS Orthoimagery Latest
description:
Combination of multiple years of orthoimagery encompassing 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024. The service provides a Natural Color view at approximately 12 inch resolution. The source orthoimagery is 4-band at resolutions of 12 or 6 inches. For more information see
